correctness.rationale: Each x_j is an integral homogeneous Chebyshev-type polynomial under an invertible unitriangular coordinate transformation of the degree-(n−2) binary Veronese map. On the dense open parameter locus the alternating Toeplitz form is a wedge of two geometric-progression vectors; all Pfaffians vanish as integer polynomial identities, hence in every characteristic. A fixed family of binom(n−2,2) Pfaffians is linearly independent by a weighted leading-chain argument. This equals the entire degree-two vanishing-space dimension of the rational normal curve, whose ideal is quadratically generated, establishing equality of *ideals*, not just reduced support. The standard Veronese coordinate ring and Eagon–Northcott resolution give the stated Hilbert series/Betti numbers. The included stand-alone standard-library checker verifies all parameterized Pfaffians and selected quadratic ranks for n=4..10; no finite check is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The Toeplitz subspace is a canonical highly nongeneric linear section of the Plücker-embedded Grassmannian, whose expected intersection dimension is negative in larger sizes. Complete all-characteristic *scheme-theoretic* identification and a minimal Pfaffian basis show smoothness, reducedness, primality, degree and all Betti numbers uniformly; general Plücker rank conditions do not supply these invariants for an arbitrary special section. The alternating case is geometrically different from the known nodal symmetric Toeplitz reduced-rank-two locus. The result is a structural classification rather than an arbitrary finite table or a simple parameter substitution.
